svg.text: Mountain courtyard house, Thailand · Owner: Max Weberman · Issue DD-01, 11 Oct 2026
Every sheet in this set and the interactive 3D model are generated from one data model:
plan.json (rooms, walls, openings, roofs, site) extended into bim.json with 1,512 elements in
twelve layers (Architecture 82, Structure 369, Framing 142, Roof 153, Electrical 383, Plumbing
160, HVAC 68, Site Utilities 10, Water + Rainwater 29, Solar 48, Controls 46, Landscape + Farm
22). Change the model and both regenerate, so drawings and 3D always match.
RC frame on spread footings, AAC + LGS walls, steel roof framing
Standing seam: butterfly (Living) + 5 shed roofs, 4-8 ft eaves
PEA 3-phase + solar/battery/generator; well + rainwater; septic + ATU; saltwater pool
Building Control Act B.E. 2522, Ministerial Regs, EIT electrical standard, DPT 1301/1302/1311
1. Allowable soil bearing 10 t/m² and footing depth 1.5 m (no soil test yet). Mountain slope may require piles or
2. RC member sizes (C1 250x250, GB1 200x500, RB1 200x400, S1 125 mm) and rebar are placeholders for a 1-storey frame at
3. Steel transfer beams TB1 over the 21 ft pocketing glass and frameless corner: assumed W250, deflection limit L/600
4. Steel rafters H-150 cantilevering 4-8 ft at eaves; uplift and connection design by engineer (DPT 1311 wind).
5. Electrical: 3-phase 400/230 V PEA service, 125 A main; load calc, cable sizes and RCBO selection to EIT standard at
6. Cooling at about 850 BTU/h per m²; VRF/multi-split outdoor units CU-1/2/3 sized by connected load, not by a heat-load
7. Plumbing pipe sizes by fixture count rule of thumb; septic + ATU and drain field sized for 6 people, perc test
8. Rainwater ring, tanks (2 x 19,000 L), well and pool routes are schematic; final routes per survey and civil grading.
9. Saltwater pool: corrosion-resistant fittings, backwash to lined soakaway; bonding/equipotential grid per EIT.
coordination and pricing. Not for permit
Model coordinates: feet, x east, y
